join_order.notes: Build supp_nation_flag[suppkey] = 0/1/2 from s_nationkey. Array is ~100KB, fits in L2 cache.
Build cust_nation_flag[custkey] = 0/1/2 from c_nationkey. Array is ~1.5MB, fits in LLC.

CRITICAL CHANGE: Do NOT pre-build orders_custkey array. During scan, use direct two-step lookup: ord_lookup[l_orderkey] -> o_rid, then o_custkey[o_rid] -> custkey, then cust_nation_flag[custkey]. Since lineitem is sorted by l_orderkey, ord_lookup and o_custkey accesses are sequential. This eliminates 240MB vector allocation + 540MB memory traffic from data_loading.

data_structures.supp_nation_flag: direct_array(uint8_t[max_suppkey+1], ~100KB, 0=none/1=FRANCE/2=GERMANY). Build by scanning s_nationkey directly since supplier is sorted by s_suppkey.
data_structures.cust_nation_flag: direct_array(uint8_t[max_custkey+1], ~1.5MB, 0=none/1=FRANCE/2=GERMANY). Build from c_nationkey using customer_c_custkey_lookup.
data_structures.orders_custkey: DO NOT BUILD. Use direct two-step lookup during scan: ord_lookup[l_orderkey] -> row_id, o_custkey[row_id] -> custkey. Both access patterns are sequential since lineitem is sorted by l_orderkey.
data_structures.aggregation: direct_array(double[2][2], indexed by [pair_id][year_idx], thread-local with final merge)

indexes.notes: Used DURING scan for direct orderkey -> row_id lookup. MADV_SEQUENTIAL since probe keys (l_orderkey) are sorted. Do NOT pre-build orders_custkey from this.
Used during pre-build of cust_nation_flag array only.

optimization_notes: Category B — algorithm change to eliminate cache-exceeding data structure. Root cause: orders_custkey pre-build (240MB vector, 5.5x LLC) dominated runtime at ~200ms (134ms allocation/init page faults + 71ms data_loading fill). Fix: eliminate orders_custkey entirely; during lineitem scan, use direct two-step lookup ord_lookup[l_orderkey] -> row_id -> o_custkey[row_id]. Since lineitem is sorted by l_orderkey, both ord_lookup and o_custkey accesses are sequential — apply MADV_SEQUENTIAL. With zonemap filtering (29% selectivity), only ~87MB additional bandwidth during parallel scan vs 540MB serial in data_loading. Kept supp_nation_flag (~100KB, L2-resident) and cust_nation_flag (~1.5MB, LLC-resident) as they are small and provide O(1) filtering. All mmap resources declared before RAII timer scope to exclude TLB shootdown. Expected: ~25-35ms total.
